title: Credit Suisse High-Tech Forum London
description: Credit Suisse hosted its first exclusive High-Tech Forum for entrepreneurs and investors in London. The Forum demonstrated Credit Suisse's ability to bring together companies seeking capital and institutional and wealthy private investors looking to invest. As a leading private and investment bank, Credit Suisse can support technology entrepreneurs and their companies at every step from early stage to exit. During the forum, Credit Suisse hosted a start-up showcase, allowing four innovative UK start-up entrepreneurs to pitch in four minutes to the Forum's audience. #hightechLondon  Guests at the forum gained exclusive insights from experts from around the globe including David Wah, Global Head of Technology Banking Division, Credit Suisse, San Francisco, Philippe Cerf, Co-Head of EMEA Technology Group, Credit Suisse, London, Lopo Champalimaud, Founder and CEO of Wahanda, Andrew Fisher, Executive Chairman of Shazam, Greg Grimaldi, Co-Head of Credit Suisse's investment fund NEXT, New York, Ian Dembinski, Head UK Domestic Clients, Credit Suisse London and Carsten Kolbek, Serial Entrepreneur and Seed Investor.  Connect with us on: LinkedIn: http://www.linkedin.com/companies/cre... Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/creditsuisse Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/creditsuisse

asr.full_text: We Are Marrying Capital With Business And Technology We are marrying capital with business and technology. And when in the capital, this is the first time really that we're looking to bring institutional money together with private client money because actually if you look at the life cycle of a business it involves both. In the last three months, what we have done is that we looked around in the UK to find some really cool startups. And we wanted startups to come here who have really cool technology, and or a very interesting new business model. Everybody, I'm James Van Rieken, the EP of Operations at Digital Shadows Andrew Carroll, Founder of eReseats Stan Gandasha, Founder and CEO of PropertyPartner I'm Tom Menright-Mooney, I'm the Chief Operating Officer at Kano, and what we're all about is how do we put the technology into the hands of these kids and get them ready for the future. I think UK is producing some really amazing startups and I think the community here is really strong, it gets stronger all the time The quality of the startups that we see coming out of the UK it gets better all the time I think we have a, I think be a really world leading location for tech startups, and so anything that helps connect those startups with the wider investment community I think is really important. All of these opportunities are all the challenges that we face as well because it's easy to start a company, it's easy to raise finance, it's easy to go to market and it's relatively easy to get it right as you've seen in those 2 year time horizons of building 100 million users to get real scale so life is actually getting a lot harder so it's tough it really is tough and I'm going to share a little bit of my thinking around what you need to do so you can be successful in that space So you look at the team that they know the market and they have complimentary skills and the talent it will take to push the business forward in the next period. Then you look at the idea, is it a new technology or is it a new U.X a new way in which the consumer will experience the service? Thirdly you look at the addressable market, it needs to be big. The bigger the better, and typically these days one wouldn't consider big market if the market was below a billion dollars. When you're growing a business you never know where the next helping hand is going to come from, and events like this are fantastic. Maybe it's a new marketing partner, someone who can make an introduction, someone who can help you with a financing issue or deal with the supply chain problem. We want those tech companies to know that we're passionate about the future and that we want to be their home and their partner, to raise capital and then realize wealth at the end of the process. I'm excited by the new, I'm excited by, you know, what's to come in the world that can be built. And as we, you know, continue to grow globally as we scale our supply chain. Having, you know, having's to come in the world that can be built. And as, you know, as we continue to grow globally, as we scale our supply chain, having access to fresh sources of capital and advisors and people that can help us is super important.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it depicts a Credit Suisse-hosted London high-tech forum for entrepreneurs and investors, including founders pitching their companies. References to capital, financing, and business partners are presented as professional fundraising and networking discussion rather than a specified rapid-return offer, payment request, credential request, guaranteed outcome, or other deceptive mechanism.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an educational and operational discussion of technology startups, including how to assess teams, ideas and markets, alongside a startup showcase and business networking context.
